steps.code: if (!defined('CLI_SCRIPT')) { define('CLI_SCRIPT', true); } require('/www/moodle/config.php'); require_once($CFG->dirroot . '/repository/lib.php'); $type = new repository_type('omeka', [], true); $typeid = $type->get_typeid(); if (!$typeid) { $typeid = $type->create(true); } $sortorder = (int)$DB->get_field_sql('SELECT MAX(sortorder) FROM {repository}'); $DB->set_field('repository', 'visible', 1, ['type' => 'omeka']); if ((int)$DB->get_field('repository', 'sortorder', ['type' => 'omeka']) === 0) { $DB->set_field('repository', 'sortorder', $sortorder + 1, ['type' => 'omeka']); } $systemcontext = context_system::instance(); $existing = $DB->get_record('repository_instances', ['typeid' => $typeid, 'contextid' => $systemcontext->id]); if (!$existing) { $params = ['name' => 'Omeka Sandbox', 'baseurl' => '{{OMEKA_BASEURL}}', 'siteid' => 0, 'keyidentity' => '', 'keycredential' => '', 'acceptedtypes' => '', 'sitelabel' => '', 'siteslug' => '']; repository::static_function('omeka', 'create', 'omeka', 0, $systemcontext, $params); } echo "omeka repository enabled and visible (typeid={$typeid})\n";

steps.summary: Test course for the Omeka-S repository plugin. The Omeka Sandbox repository instance is preconfigured against {{OMEKA_BASEURL}}.
